evidence.observation: Purge brought exhaust O2 down from 28766 to 15 ppm; it stayed at about 3-5 ppm afterwards.
Thermocouple followed the ramp setpoint to within about 0.5 °C.
Temperature overshot to 761.4 °C when growth started and heater power dropped to 40%.
Temperature is settling at 752.5 °C against the 750 °C setpoint.
Pressure is about 760 Torr and Ar flow about 100 sccm, both steady.

args.missing_evidence: No reference ranges are given, so I can't confirm the size of the overshoot or the hold power against normal runs. No characterization of the sample exists yet.
